title: Island Voices - Guthan nan Eilean
description:
The Island Voices Multilingual Archive will launch at Cultarlann Inbhir Nis in Inverness on Monday 23 November 2026. Featuring almost 40 languages, it brings together recordings created with communities in the Western Isles, across Scotland and internationally.

The archive preserves the first 21 years of Island Voices/Guthan nan Eilean, a community project founded by Gordon Wells in 2005. Rooted in Gaelic-speaking communities, it captures “slices of life in and beyond the 21st century Hebrides”, with people sharing their stories, knowledge and experiences in their own words.

Visitors can explore conversations, memories, songs, poetry and documentaries in languages including Gaelic, English, Scots, Shaetlan, Irish and Welsh. International collaborations extend to South Asia and the Caribbean.
address: Cultarlann Inbhir Nis, 68 Academy St, Inverness, IV1 1LP

title: Meantime at Cultarlann Inbhir Nis: Cèilidh 's dannsa
description:
Highland Cèilidh with MeanTime

Join us for an unforgettable evening of traditional music, lively dancing, and warm Highland hospitality!

We are thrilled to welcome MeanTime, one of Scotland’s finest West Coast cèilidh bands, to Inverness. Renowned for their infectious energy, stirring bagpipe sets, foot-stomping fiddles, and rich Gaelic vocals, MeanTime brings the true spirit of a West Coast cèilidh straight to the dance floor.

title: Consairt na Nollaig - Brian agus a chàirdean
description:
Thig dhan Chultarlann airson oidhche de dh’òran àlainn leis an teaghlach de sheinneadairean cliùiteach à dh'Inbhir Nis: Brian Ó hEadhra, Fionnag NicChoinnich, Órla Ní Eadhra, agus Ró Ó hEadhra (BFÓR).

Bidh BFÓR a’ lìbhrigeadh co-sheirm binn agus taghadh tarraingeach de dh’ òrain thraidiseanta agus ùr-nòsach ann an Gàidhlig agus Beurla.


Join us for an evening of live song with the acclaimed Inverness family of singers: Brian Ó hEadhra, Fionnag NicChoinnich, Órla Ní Eadhra, and Ró Ó hEadhra (BFÓR) at Cultarlann Inbhir Nis.

As a family ensemble, BFÓR brings together rich harmonies and unique arrangements of both traditional and contemporary songs in Gaelic and English.

title: Cèilidh na Bliadhn' Ùire at Cultarlann Inbhir Nis: Inverness Hogmanay 2026
description:

Cèilidh na Bliadhn' Ùire at Cultarlann Inbhir Nis: Inverness Hogmanay 2026

We are proud to welcome the West Loch Cèilidh Band to our 2026 Hogmany celebration. 

Great music, lively cèilidh dancing, a relaxed additional area, songs, tunes and great company - the Cultarlann Cèilidh will have it all.

  • 9pm to 1am with a great mix of dancing, music, community and cosy atmosphere. 

  • This is a great way to bring in the new year and welcome 2027.

title: Rachel & Holli - Scottish Traditional Music
description: Rachel and Holli are an award-winning duo on the Scottish traditional music scene. They first met in 2016 while participating in the Argyll Ceilidh Trail and have since honed their  individual craft as musicians, performers and teachers. Fiddler player Holli Scott has extensive experience playing across the Scottish ceilidh and session scene, while accordion player and pianist, Rachel Campbell, graduated in 2022 from the Royal Conservatoire of Scotland with a BMus in Traditional Music. The pair have performed separately across Scotland and in various other places including Spain, Germany and New Zealand.
address: Cultarlann Inbhir Nis, 68 Academy St, Inverness, IV1 1LP
